response.query: What definition and calibration protocol for a confidence_score maps provenance, freshness, and audit findings into operational decision thresholds?
response.answer: A confidence score maps provenance, freshness, and audit findings into thresholds for operational decisions. Calibration involves adjusting the score to reflect real-time data accuracy and reliability. The score determines when to act based on data integrity.

results.title: AIAG Finished Vehicle Logistics (FVL)
results.content: Discover best practices for reducing costs and improving finished vehicle supply chain management processes. AIAG’s Finished Vehicle Logistics (FVL) program is powered by the collective insights of AIAG member volunteers representing rail, truck, ocean carrier, custom broker, and terminal operating organizations. Together we have made significant strides in improving processes while reducing complexities in the finished vehicle logistics supply chain. AIAG and their M-22 FVL Transportation Damage Handling Processes guideline have been instrumental in standardizing the processes followed by all stakeholders in the new vehicle transportation network (OEMs, railroads, car-haul carriers, ocean carriers, and yard managers). Anyone new to this part of the vehicle business can get a quick and detailed overview of how the 'damage inspection and reporting process' should be done. The all-inclusive Damage Prevention Committee, overseen by AIAG managers, ensures that the M-22 stays up to date with the latest behaviors and technology in the vehicle shipping arena.
